title: SAM3 as the masking foundation - refiner swap + points rewrite
description: Adopt SAM3 (sam3.1_multiplex_fp16, 1.75GB, SAM License - commercially clear) as the mask refiner and the points engine. Measured live on our own 0.28.0 engine: SAM3 box refine 1.7s vs SAM 1 vit_b 2.1-3.1s and visibly crisper; SAM3 points 1.1s from a single dot. The points path becomes plain JSON pixel coords (positive_coords / negative_coords), retiring the r=8 / r=4 dot-radius polarity hack, the snapping Scope threshold, and the staged points-mask PNG (one less media upload per remote run). SAM3 does NOT replace YOLO: it cannot enumerate, and 4 text categories already cost 10.5s where COCO YOLO does 80 classes in 0.5s - so MPI-379 keeps YOLO as the hover enumerator and this card supplies the refine step it clicks into. Also unlocks video: SAM3_VideoTrack + SAM3_TrackToMask take an initial_mask, which is what Bernini and the Wan Animate style graphs will need. Full measurements, six engine traps and the licence verdict are in brief.md - READ IT before starting.
